# Raveen's Blog

> Personal research blog by Raveen Beemsingh exploring ideas at the intersection of epistemology, AI, and software engineering.

This site contains three main projects:

## Popper's Knowledge Tensor (PKT)

A speculative neuro-symbolic framework proposing hard falsification (rejecting hypotheses that fail deductive tests) as an alternative to soft constraint satisfaction in AI. The core claim: existing neuro-symbolic systems nudge learning toward logic; PKT would reject hypotheses that fail deductive tests. This is active research — proposed, not proven.

- [Overview](https://raveenb.github.io/popper/): Thesis statement and roadmap
- [Motivation](https://raveenb.github.io/popper/motivation/): Why pure induction (self-supervised learning) is insufficient — hallucination as a structural symptom
- [Philosophy](https://raveenb.github.io/popper/theory/): Popper's falsificationism, Hegel's dialectic, Foucault's episteme — treated as three distinct traditions
- [Landscape](https://raveenb.github.io/popper/landscape/): Survey of Logic Tensor Networks, DeepProbLog, NeurASP, Constitutional AI, Neural Theorem Provers — and how PKT differs
- [Framework](https://raveenb.github.io/popper/math/): Formal definitions — Knowledge Tensor, Falsification Operator, combined loss function, convergence conjecture (all speculative)
- [Open Questions](https://raveenb.github.io/popper/questions/): Is knowledge universal or emergent? Does it require agency? Can AI develop knowledge autonomously?
- [Research Log](https://raveenb.github.io/popper/blog/): Popperian falsification log — documents what was believed and later corrected

Key technical terms: Knowledge Tensor (T), Falsification Operator (F), hard vs. soft constraints, alternating optimization, CP tensor decomposition.

## Rube Goldberg AI

An exploratory essay asking whether AI can or should engage in structured inefficiency — doing things the hard way for the learning and serendipity it produces.

- [Essay](https://raveenb.github.io/rube-goldberg/): Argues that play and inefficiency are not bugs but features — in human cognition (dumbbells, serendipity), in biology (Darwin: evolution satisfices, never optimizes), and potentially in AI. References Sagan, Mallory, Schmidhuber's artificial curiosity, Pathak et al.'s curiosity-driven exploration.

## AI in the Garden

A personal essay about using AI to help manage a diverse 50+ species garden, and a speculative exploration of what comes next — from AI as consultant (current) to AI as observer (sensors, drones) to AI as actor (intervention, diagnosis, garden redesign).

- [Essay](https://raveenb.github.io/ai-garden/): Grounded in real experience using Claude for plant diagnostics, soil testing, and species management. Explores the progression from AI-as-text-consultant to AI-in-the-physical-world. Discusses irreversibility, feedback systems, and why the physical world is fundamentally harder than the digital one. Connects to PKT's questions about AI agency and autonomous knowledge development.
- [Bougainvillea](https://raveenb.github.io/ai-garden/bougainvillea/): How AI-guided stress treatment (less water, bloom-focused fertilizer, pH correction) transformed five plants into a wall of pink and white.
- [Night Jasmine](https://raveenb.github.io/ai-garden/night-jasmine/): pH correction unlocked explosive growth in nitya malli — from quiet to copious flowers and fragrance.
- [Hibiscus](https://raveenb.github.io/ai-garden/hibiscus/): AI differential diagnosis of a yellow hibiscus — ruling out nutrients, pests, and pH to identify a suspected virus. Nine plants bloom while one fights.
- [Plumeria](https://raveenb.github.io/ai-garden/plumeria/): Targeted phosphorus and potassium feeding produced flower clusters on every stem.
- [Roses](https://raveenb.github.io/ai-garden/roses/): pH correction and Epsom salt produced larger, brighter blooms — and AI taught patience during natural rest cycles.

## About the Author

Raveen Beemsingh — exploring epistemology, AI, and software engineering. The blog is a thinking tool; ideas are developed in public and documented honestly, including what turned out to be wrong.
